notes.title: 2nd Update!
notes.content:
Hi there!


I've been very busy but I've got some time to add things and improvements to the game.



In this update a small ending has been added to give closure to the game and to make the window rescalable, as some of you requested.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637381/9690900262d7e9e0a8cffc6ba4cea6d8673f5df1.gif"]



So far the improvements are:



- Speed increase button in the postures.

- Window mode.

- Added the Hobgoblin

- New posture for Hobgoblin.

- Added Elf.

- Kiss" pose for Elf.

- New sexual posture for elf.

- Rescalable game window.

- Small closing cinematic.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637381/b18c197b636cf8bba23701144c6f562f71b2b12a.png"]



I still want to add some more things, but it will have to be little by little.

Thanks for your understanding and support of the project.

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
Hi! \\(^o^)/

I've been looking for some time away from work to improve my game. Not everything I want to put in yet, but little by little!

As I said, the game will remain simple and will consist of unlocking ingredients and poses, focusing on the quality of the animation. Believe me, frame-by-frame animation is no easy task!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637381/4ae19a7d6b7516b08a68befba8a831360580c703.gif"]

What does this first update bring?

- Window mode option (thanks to your feedback).

- Option to make the Goblin bar go at x10 speed (you're welcome).

- New unlockable character: The Elf.

- Stances for the elf.

- Special “Kiss” pose for the elf.

- New stance for the Orc (It looks great!)

- Now the game indicates when you have finished all recipes.


*If you already made extra potions without knowing it, you may have already unlocked the new content!


For future updates:

- Gallery mode.

- Change the hair color of the witch.

- Other postures + Ingredient “Witch's Orgasms”.



Thank you very much for your patience and feedback.

I work alone on this part time, I will try to give my best.



However, I want to emphasize once again, that this will remain a game of simple mechanics, it is not a fun game, it is focused on its practical use.

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.content:
Hi there!!! \\(^o^)/  With “Witch Seed: Goblin Slave Alchemy” just released, I am already working on an update.



The game system will be kept simple, it is one of the premises of this game since the beginning of its development. All the weight is for the production of quality animations frame by frame. The animations of this game are composed of hundreds of drawings!


- New poses will be added,

- The witch will be able to change her hair color.

- A new character will be added (an elf)

- It will have a cinematic Ending.



Any kind of proposal or idea that you would like to see in the game, I'm open to requests, I'm listening! steamthumbsup



Thank you very much!

Greetings!
